verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of bulk processing is the image API's batch generation of multiple images in one request. That is a narrow, single-modality form of bulk work, not general bulk operations across many existing items such as records, files or emails. Multi-image editing (up to five sources) combines inputs into one edit, and the Salesforce connector creates individual records, so neither counts. Missing for 10: general bulk or batch operations over many existing items (records, files, messages), a batch API for text or agent tasks, documented limits and behavior, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: The API supports batch generation of multiple images, and control over aspect ratio, resolution, and quality.
